title: Rafael and the Trail
author: Coral Whitlock
blurb: Isandro Dravenmoor, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
